Percentage* of Children and Adolescents Aged 1–17 Years Who Received an Influenza Vaccine Within the Past 12 Months
52.4% of children and adolescents aged 1–17 years received an influenza vaccine within the previous 12 months.
The percentage was highest in children and adolescents with private insurance (56.6%), followed by those with public insurance (48.6%)
This pattern was seen in each age group.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.
